insights.title: Winter vs monsoon
insights.text: Median BC is 4.2× higher in winter (6,334 ng/m³) than in the monsoon (1,501 ng/m³).

insights.title: Worst hour in winter
insights.text: Winter BC peaks around 22:00 (median 10,241 ng/m³) and is lowest around 15:00 (3,512).

insights.title: Stagnation effect (winter)
insights.text: On near-calm winter hours (wind 0–0.5) median BC is 7,567 ng/m³ versus 4,297 when wind is 1.5–2 m/s.

insights.title: BC as a share of PM2.5
insights.text: BC makes up ~24.3% of PM2.5 in winter versus ~10.5% in the monsoon (median).

insights.title: Pollution episodes
insights.text: 360 episodes (BC above the site's top 10% for ≥3 h) were found; 79% were in winter, median duration 4.5 h, most often starting around 18:00.

insights.title: Diwali night
insights.text: Evening-to-early-morning BC around Diwali was on average 1.3× the surrounding days (range 0.1–2.0×, 4 year(s) with data).

insights.title: Weekday vs weekend
insights.text: Weekend BC is +6% relative to weekdays on average.
